column1: # POOT-1614 calibrate-launch rocm packedgemv on Strix Halo (gfx1151, 40 compute units, ROCm/HSA, local box, 2026-11-16 22:50-23:43 JST), master 478b8f391: the 15 cells of the sm_120 corpus (ptx-sm120-packed-gemv.tsv), every (cols, rows | N, run 32/16/8/4, depth) the format admits; 2488 rows, 14 geometries refused (iq4_xs 5120x17408 cols 32: the output disagrees with the reference, worst 0.0020). Box: gpu_busy_percent 0-6 before the run and 2-17 sampled every 15 s during it with our own kernels in the mix; the only other GPU clients were the idle desktop, an idle llama-server and an idle ComfyUI. Run-to-run repeat of the run-16 geometries of three cells (126 rows, reversed order): repeat/first median 0.99-1.00, sd 0.04-0.05 (min 0.82, max 1.17), several times the sm_120 spread, so a pick within about 5 % of the fastest is not distinguished. The lines and warp_instructions columns are the generator at master (every column group pays its activation read). Same columns as ptx-sm120-packed-gemv.tsv: format NxK cols rows run depth device_us warp_instructions lines units warp_lanes width weight_bytes
